cpp_shape: Objective-C strong fields, nullable id returns, and borrowed selector arguments.
rust_rule: Owned native fields use Retained<T>; nullable ownership uses Option<Retained<T>>; borrowed arguments remain references for the shortest valid scope.
invariant: Publication occurs only after every required retained object exists; replacement retains the new object before releasing the old one.
forbidden: Raw native pointers stored without an owner; extending a borrow beyond its source scope; treating nil as a valid initialized owner.

cpp_shape: rcp<T>, zero-reference callbacks, pool ownership, and manager purgatory.
rust_rule: Use Arc only when ordinary shared ownership matches; otherwise use an explicit logical refcount and allocation owner that preserves the zero-reference transition.
invariant: The final logical release follows the pinned immediate-delete, deferred-purgatory, or pool-recycle branch exactly and concrete payload Drop is preserved.
forbidden: Replacing source intrusive semantics with Arc strong_count inference, resurrecting an Arc from zero, or weakening a source strong owner.

cpp_shape: Span, pointer-plus-length, typed upload rings, offsets, and C++ size arithmetic.
rust_rule: Use borrowed slices for borrowed spans, owned byte containers only at an ownership transfer, and checked conversions/arithmetic before native selectors or allocation.
invariant: Exact byte length, element count, alignment, sentinel placement, and offset growth match the pinned producer and consumer.
forbidden: Unchecked truncation, inferred lengths that ignore authored size, realignment by copying without evidence, or saturating away an overflow.

cpp_shape: C++ enum discriminants, bit flags, generated binding indices, absent sentinels, and Metal pixel formats.
rust_rule: Use explicit Rust discriminants or exhaustive conversion tables; retain generated names and absent-slot sentinels as source constants.
invariant: Every upstream value maps one-to-one or fails closed before mutation; shader keys and native indices are never derived from Rust declaration order.
forbidden: Implicit enum repr assumptions, slot renumbering, lossy integer casts, or substituting WGPU format and binding policy.

cpp_shape: assert, RIVE_UNREACHABLE, nullable native failures, NSError, and recoverable factory returns.
rust_rule: Keep a hard failure only when the Rust caller proves the same unreachable invariant; otherwise return a stable typed error before publishing or mutating state.
invariant: Failure decision order and caller-visible observability match pinned behavior unless a documented safe-Rust correction deliberately strengthens it.
forbidden: Panicking on hostile public input, success-returning no-op, swallowed native error, partial publication, or fixture-specific Unsupported routing.

cpp_shape: Background compiler thread, condition variables, command-buffer completion blocks, ring transfer, and context destruction.
rust_rule: Represent worker shutdown and completion as explicit owners; transfer each submitted lease exactly once; run native callbacks with only the source-intended retained state.
invariant: Pending work cannot strand waiters; command success and failure both release transferred resources; context drop cannot release in-flight storage early.
forbidden: Detached worker lifetime, completion inferred from submission, callback capture cycles, double release, or synchronous wait substituted for an upstream async ownership contract without a recorded adaptation.

cpp_shape: Apple platform macros, simulator branches, WITH_RIVE_TOOLS, RIVE_CANVAS, TARGET_OS_IPHONE, and Objective-C header modes.
rust_rule: Translate behavior into explicit cfg or typed platform/configuration values and keep every branch in the exhaustive configuration ledger.
invariant: Each pinned branch compiles and behaves under its declared configuration, or remains visibly review-needed with a documented exclusion.
forbidden: Collapsing device and simulator behavior, silently treating macOS as every non-iOS target, omitting tools layout fields, or calling an uncompiled branch supported.

cpp_shape: Reverse C++ member destruction, derived-before-base destruction, autorelease scopes, and native command retention.
rust_rule: Order Rust fields or introduce a narrow owner wrapper so observable payload, manager, compiler, cache, and native releases occur in the source-required sequence.
invariant: Every dependent owner remains alive through its final destructor/callback use; autoreleased native references are measured only after the pool drains.
forbidden: Assuming Rust declaration order matches C++ reverse-member order, testing native deallocation before autorelease drain, or relying on Metal to retain an object without source/API evidence.
